title: Vector database: Qdrant against brute-force dense search
why: A vector database is the standard retrieval store of production RAG systems.
notes: 2004 documents and 143 queries of the frozen retrieval set, the same embedder for both arms; Qdrant location `:memory:` (local mode, no server).
The forecast-time rule (a document must have resolved before the query's as-of time) is a payload filter inside Qdrant and is covered by unit tests.
limits: Local mode scans vectors like brute force, so its latency says nothing about a server with an HNSW index; the CI job `vectordb` runs the same tests against a Qdrant server container.
Two thousand documents are far below the size where an approximate index matters.
